Container.Name: Sideline
Container.Overview: Sideline is a self-hosted fantasy football analyzer for Sleeper leagues. It reads your league from Sleeper's public API (no login needed) and shows lineup optimization, waiver targets, FAAB suggestions, trends, and matchup views, all computed under your league's exact scoring rules. Runs as a single container with a web server and a background sync worker; data is stored in SQLite under the /data path you map below. See https://github.com/sideline/sideline/blob/main/docs/self-hosting.md for the full install and configuration guide.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web app listens on. Map it to a different host port if 3000 is already in use.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database, caches, and automatic pre-migration backups (keeps the 5 most recent).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that should own files under /data. Unraid's usual 'nobody' id is 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that should own files under /data. Unraid's usual 'users' group id is 100.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Display timezone, an IANA name such as America/New_York.

Config.Name: APP_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Set this to turn on password login for the web app. Leave empty for no password. WARNING: the login rate limiter trusts X-Forwarded-For from a reverse proxy; if you port-forward the WebUI Port straight to the internet with no proxy (e.g. Nginx Proxy Manager) in front, an attacker can spoof that header and bypass the rate limiter entirely. Without a reverse proxy, treat this password as a LAN-only convenience, not real protection. See docs/self-hosting.md 'Enabling the password'.

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: Required when APP_PASSWORD is set. At least 32 characters. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: SLEEPER_USERNAME
Config.Description: Your Sleeper username. Optional; the app's onboarding screen can set it instead.

Config.Name: DEFAULT_LEAGUE_ID
Config.Description: Sleeper league id to open by default. Optional.

Config.Name: ENABLE_NFLVERSE
Config.Description: Pull supplementary nflverse player data. true or false.

Config.Name: ODDS_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional API key for betting odds. Leave empty to disable that feature.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log verbosity: fatal, error, warn, info, debug, or trace.

Config.Name: SYNC_STATE_CRON
Config.Description: Cron override for the state sync job. Leave empty for the built-in default.

Config.Name: SYNC_LEAGUE_CRON
Config.Description: Cron override for the league sync job. Leave empty for the built-in default.

Config.Name: SYNC_USERS_CRON
Config.Description: Cron override for the users sync job. Leave empty for the built-in default.

Config.Name: SYNC_ROSTERS_CRON
Config.Description: Cron override for the rosters sync job. Leave empty for the built-in default.

Config.Name: SYNC_MATCHUPS_CRON
Config.Description: Cron override for the matchups sync job. Leave empty for the built-in default.

Config.Name: SYNC_TRANSACTIONS_CRON
Config.Description: Cron override for the transactions sync job. Leave empty for the built-in default.

Config.Name: SYNC_PLAYERS_CRON
Config.Description: Cron override for the players sync job. Leave empty for the built-in default.

Config.Name: SYNC_TRENDING_CRON
Config.Description: Cron override for the trending sync job. Leave empty for the built-in default.

Config.Name: SYNC_STATS_CRON
Config.Description: Cron override for the stats sync job. Leave empty for the built-in default.

Config.Name: SYNC_PROJECTIONS_CRON
Config.Description: Cron override for the projections sync job. Leave empty for the built-in default.

Config.Name: SYNC_NFLVERSE_CRON
Config.Description: Cron override for the nflverse sync job. Leave empty for the built-in default.
